parts.html: The K-08 standard model is a straight minimalist kitchen: brown fronts with a wood pattern and simply shaped cabinets.
When every front is wood, it is better to keep the walls, floor, and countertop around it light or neutral: light plaster, stone, an understated floor.
All the K-08 fronts, upper and lower, are made of HPL-faced MDF in one wood decor, with no change of material between the rows.
The 4.2-linear-meter kitchen takes up one wall, leaving room for a dining table.
The upper cabinets open upward on FREE SPACE Hafele lift-up mechanisms, and the doors close smoothly on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges.
Hinges: Muller Profi Line with soft-close mechanisms
We recalculate the K-08 dimensions for your wall, utility connections, and built-in appliances. We make the kitchen in our own workshop, then deliver and install it in Bratislava or Vienna.
